sources.name: ari-curious
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent 2D narrative-game character portrait for TrustTrail. Create an ORIGINAL fictional protagonist named Ari, a 22-year-old Indonesian fresh graduate, shown from waist up, turned three-quarter toward the viewer's right. Warm medium-brown skin, short slightly wavy black hair with one recognizable loose forelock, dark expressive eyebrows, slim ordinary build, and a quiet thoughtful face. A deep desaturated teal overshirt with rolled sleeves over an ivory T-shirt. One hand lightly rests at the chin: attentive curiosity, not fear or exaggerated comedy. Strong readable silhouette, slightly enlarged expressive head, confident imperfect charcoal-ink contours, flat gouache color shapes, restrained paper grain and two-step cel-like shadows. Modern hand-illustrated graphic narrative game, no photorealism, no 3D, no generic anime, no glossy vector stock illustration. Palette: midnight #111827 contours, slate #1f3544 shadows, muted teal clothing, ivory and warm amber reflected light. Soft amber key light from upper left. Frame the COMPLETE hair, both shoulders, elbows and waist with generous transparent margin; no cropped hands or head. Genuinely transparent background. NO words, numbers, logos, watermark, scenery, interface or dialogue balloon. A reusable sprite with a clear likeness that can retain the same features in other expressions.

Left foreground is quieter dark negative space so a separate character sprite can stand there; right two-thirds have readable broad shapes behind an optional HTML artifact window. Desk, window and shelf have specific silhouettes, warm amber raking light against deep slate-blue shadows. Slightly exaggerated angular perspective, strong hand-drawn charcoal contours, flat gouache shapes, restrained grain, layered foreground/midground/background, cohesive with Image 1. Palette midnight #111827, slate #1f3544, muted teal, paper ivory #f5f3ee and amber #f0b35a. No characters, no readable text, no letters/numbers/logos, no message or UI on laptop, no controls, no annotation, no gradients as graphic decoration, no 3D, no photorealism. Original room layout; do not imitate any existing game's locations.
